stations.title: Ines
stations.say: Can the laptop print our note?
stations.note: A note goes in every parcel.

stations.title: Shop laptop
stations.text: Prints a good morning and an old offer.

stations.title: Parcel note
stations.text: Printed and ready for the box.

captions: First day at Wickhollow Candles. Ines wants the laptop to print the parcel note.
Today the laptop prints a good morning and an old offer, but no note.
You write the lines that print it, in four small tasks.
Now the welcome and the note print, and the old offer is switched off.
One file, run with node. The laptop talks, and Ines has her note.
